# Densy

Densy is a light theme that trades whitespace for content density: padding and margins are cut across the interface, labels are minimized to fit their content while being made larger and darker, and icons are enlarged and packed closer together so they can sit nearer one another. The README also records removed window controls and tab close buttons, and a tab-selection target that extends to the screen edge when the window is maximized.

![Densy screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenesvk/Obsidian-Densy/HEAD/img/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Densy"
    author: "eugenesvk"
    repo:   "eugenesvk/Obsidian-Densy"
    slug:   "densy"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/densy"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/eugenesvk/Obsidian-Densy"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenesvk/Obsidian-Densy/HEAD/img/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light"]
}
```
